name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve
description: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, on an island in the St Lawrence. Straights and chicanes, very hard on the brakes, and the Wall of Champions waiting at the last one.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (907 of 1744 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
